global: Hear me, all who bear steel in good conscience: {my_faction} marches on {fief} and seeks worthy swords.
The ancestors of {my_faction} did not raise their banners for cowards. Who among you will ride with us to {fief}?
Ser, the last raid on {fief} ended with a goose in my boots, so I beg you bring a better stomach and a sharper blade.
Those who mocked {my_faction} at the last feast now beg for a place in our ranks. Think on it, and be quick.
Stand with {my_faction} against {enemy_faction}, or stand aside and watch your roads burn. The choice is yours, friend.
An oath is only as heavy as the deeds that follow it, so I ask who here will bind their word to {fief}.
Weary I am of ledgers and empty promises. Should you wish to earn a name that will outlast your bones, ride with {my_faction}.
Mark my words, traveller, {enemy_faction} has grown fat and careless, and I mean to see its gates broken by spring.
Gather at the gate of {my_faction} before the next sunrise. Those who arrive late will be remembered for it.
Travellers of the road, a word: the roads toward {fief} are about to grow loud, and I need shields for the vanguard.
